name: Aemeath

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Sword Main DPS with a Form Switch mechanic (Aemeath <-> Mech), 2 Forte resources (Synchronization Rate 0-200, Resonance Rate 0-4), and a 'Resonance Mode' toggle (Tune Rupture vs Fusion Burst) that changes her Intro/Basic effects and Forte (Duet) enhancements; also enables Mono Fusion play via Lupa.

skills.normalAttack: Infinity Calibration - up to 4-hit strings in either Aemeath or Mech form; charged Heavy Attacks count as Liberation DMG.
skills.resonanceSkill: Shared Voyage - Form Switch between Aemeath/Mech; Sync Strikes (Armament Merge / Call of Dawn) available after specific basic-attack stages.
skills.forte: To Sculpt the Silence - at Synchronization Rate 100, casts Seraphic Duet (Overture in Aemeath form / Encore in Mech form), consumed Resonance Liberation DMG, enhanced by current Resonance Mode (Tune Rupture or Fusion Burst).
skills.liberation: Towards the Daybreak - Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive (switches to Mech, grants Stardust Resonance + Unbound state); second Ultimate Heavenfall Edict: Finale usable once both Forte resources are maxed, big AoE nuke that clears trash.
skills.intro: Overture of Departure - Songs Across the Universe (Aemeath form) / Debut of Meteoric Radiance (Mech form), grants Starlume Acceleration.
skills.outro: Silent Protection - grants team (excl. Aemeath) 10-20% All-DMG Amplification for 20s depending on Resonance Mode responders.

echoSet: Trailblazing Star (5pc, dedicated set: +20% CRIT Rate & Fusion DMG Bonus)

teams.name: Best Fusion Burst Team
teams.notes: Strongest AoE/quickswap archetype; Lupa on Moonlit Clouds, Denia on Flaming Clawprint.

teams.name: Best Tune Rupture Team
teams.notes: Best single-target ceiling; Mornye ideal support since Aemeath self-applies Tune Rupture.

teams.name: Mono Fusion
teams.notes: Lupa enables party-wide Fusion RES Ignore/DMG Bonus; Changli only better than Brant in quickswap.

rotation: Standard: Skill (Mech form) opener -> Intro -> Mech Basics -> Ultimate (Overdrive) -> Basics -> Skill (Duet Encore) -> Aemeath Basics -> Skill (Duet Overture) -> Heavy (Mech II) -> Ultimate (Finale) -> Outro. Advanced Quickswap variant delays Intro by ~4s of off-field basics to line up with short Outro buffs (e.g. Changli).
communityNotes: Prydwen: current strongest Fusion DPS (T0/T0.5), flexible across 3 team archetypes (Tune Rupture, Fusion Burst, Mono Fusion) each enabled by a different secondary (Lynae, Denia, Lupa respectively); main weakness is Forte generation requiring melee Basic Attacks to actually land, punished by airborne/evasive enemies, and lacks a permanently-accessible premium teammate the way Phrolova/Augusta do.
